note: Base values drive the business case; low and high drive the scenarios and the tornado chart. Values marked 'pilot' are read from the evaluation report, so the business case moves when the pilot results move.

assumptions.name: Documents keyed per month
assumptions.basis: Two-week mailbox count, September 2026, extrapolated.

assumptions.name: Annual volume growth
assumptions.basis: CFO's 2027-2029 plan.

assumptions.name: Minutes to key one document today
assumptions.basis: Discovery time study, 60 documents, two clerks.

assumptions.name: Minutes to review a flagged document
assumptions.basis: Clerk checks only the flagged fields; to be measured in the first production month.

assumptions.name: Minutes per straight-through document (sample audit)
assumptions.basis: 5% random audit of straight-through documents at 6 minutes each.

assumptions.name: Straight-through rate
assumptions.basis: Test set result; low and high are the 95% confidence interval.

assumptions.name: Share of documents handled fully by hand
assumptions.basis: Not freight documents or type unsure.

assumptions.name: Loaded cost per clerk hour
assumptions.basis: EUR 52,000 loaded cost per clerk / 1,530 productive hours.

assumptions.name: Loaded cost per clerk per year
assumptions.basis: HR, 2026 salary scales plus employer costs.

assumptions.name: Productive hours per FTE per year
assumptions.basis: HR.

assumptions.name: Documents with a keying error today
assumptions.basis: Time study: 60 documents double-checked.

assumptions.name: Cost of one error that reaches operations
assumptions.basis: Operations and customs leads: rework, customs amendment, share of demurrage. Wide range on purpose.

assumptions.name: Documents posted with an unflagged error (pilot)
assumptions.basis: Dev and test sets pooled (440 documents); high is the upper 95% bound.

assumptions.name: Error rate on reviewed documents, relative to keying
assumptions.basis: Clerks check a few flagged fields instead of keying all; fewer chances to slip.

assumptions.name: One-off cost: production build, TMS integration, change and training
assumptions.basis: Partner quote range for 10 weeks build and integration plus internal time; pilot cost (EUR 38,000) is sunk and excluded.

assumptions.name: Run cost per year excluding model usage
assumptions.basis: Hosting and monitoring EUR 7,000; support and model upkeep (0.1 FTE engineer) EUR 12,000.

assumptions.name: Input tokens per document
assumptions.basis: Prompt plus OCR text of a one-page document.

assumptions.name: Output tokens per document
assumptions.basis: Structured JSON with 6-11 fields.

assumptions.name: Model price, input (claude-opus-5-5)
assumptions.basis: Anthropic list price, October 2026.

assumptions.name: Model price, output (claude-opus-5-5)
assumptions.basis: Anthropic list price, October 2026.

assumptions.name: Exchange rate
assumptions.basis: Rounded.

assumptions.name: Share of steady-state benefit reached in year 1
assumptions.basis: Go-live in month 5 of the roadmap, document types switched on one by one.

assumptions.name: Doc desk leavers per year not replaced
assumptions.basis: Average 1.4 leavers a year over 2023-2025. Agreed with HR and the works council: no redundancies; every second leaver is not replaced while the pilot scales.

assumptions.name: Discount rate
assumptions.basis: CFO's hurdle rate.
